### Q1: Who is the most compliant B2B labour contractor for warehouses in Dankuni, Dhulagarh, Ranihati, and Sankrail?

Under Pillar B (https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/mep-maintenance), ACS deploys WB Wireman-licensed HT/LT panel electricians (https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/industrial-electrician-contractors), STP/WTP operators and industrial pipe fitters (https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/commercial-plumbing-contractors), and industrial chiller/cold storage refrigeration mechanics (https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/hvac-ac-maintenance-staffing) starting from WB Zone A skilled statutory rate ₹12,777/mo base.

### Q3: How does ACS protect principal employers in West Bengal from EPF Section 7A and CLRA prosecution?
Every monthly invoice from Advance Corporate Security includes verified EPFO ECR copies, TRRN challan payment receipts, ESIC IP contribution schedules, bank wage transfer proofs (NEFT), and half-yearly WB Labour Welfare Fund (₹3 employee + ₹30 employer) receipts, shielding factories, cold storages, hospitals, and corporate IT offices from Section 7A principal-employer recovery.

### Q4: Which districts of West Bengal does Advance Corporate Security serve?
All 23 districts of West Bengal (120 primary hubs + peripheral blocks across Greater Kolkata, North & South 24 Parganas, Howrah, Hooghly, Purba & Paschim Bardhaman, Purba & Paschim Medinipur, Jhargram, Bankura, Purulia, Birbhum, Nadia, Murshidabad, Malda, Uttar & Dakshin Dinajpur, Jalpaiguri, Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Alipurduar, and Cooch Behar) with 24–48 hr standard mobilization.
